description: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope and ALMA have uncovered how a massive black hole shut down star formation in Pablo’s Galaxy. Powerful winds expelled gas at hundreds of kilometres per second, leaving almost no cold fuel behind. The findings suggest many early galaxies did not die explosively, but were slowly starved by their central black holes in the young universe.
title: A Massive Black Hole Starved Pablo’s Galaxy, Ending Its Star Formation

description: India experienced its first space launch failure of 2026 on January 12 when the PSLV-C62 mission malfunctioned during its third stage. A technical anomaly caused the rocket to deviate from its intended trajectory, preventing it from reaching orbital velocity. As a result, the EOS-N1 Earth observation satellite and 15 smaller companion satellites re-entered Earth’s atmosphere and burned up. ISRO has since constituted a failure analysis committee to investigate the third-stage glitch and identify corrective measures.
title: PSLV-C62 Failure Marks India’s First Space Launch Setback of 2026

description: This list highlights some of the best colour laser printers currently available in India for homes, small offices, and growing businesses. It covers compact printers for light workloads as well as multifunction machines built for higher volumes. The featured models focus on key factors such as print quality, speed, connectivity, paper handling, and long-term running costs. Options from Canon, HP, and Brother address different budgets and use cases, helping buyers choose a reliable colour laser printer suited to their daily printing needs.
title: Best Colour Laser Printers 2026 in India: Prices, Models and Features

description: Laser and inkjet printers serve different needs, and the right choice depends on your printing habits. Laser printers are designed for speed, sharp text, and regular high-volume use, making them a better fit for offices and heavy workloads. Inkjet printers focus on colour detail and flexibility, which suits home users and occasional printing. In India, inkjets are cheaper to buy, while lasers cost more upfront but save money over time. Looking at usage, costs, and output helps you decide which printer makes sense.
title: Laser vs Inkjet Printers: Key Differences and Buying Guide

description: Scientists are studying 100 possible alien radio signals identified from Arecibo Observatory data, bringing the 21-year SETI@Home project to a close. Supported by millions of volunteers, the effort found no confirmed alien messages but set new sensitivity standards. Researchers say the findings will guide future searches using more powerful radio telescopes.
title: Scientists Study 100 Possible Alien Signals as Arecibo’s Historic SETI Search Concludes

description: According to IDC's latest report, the global smartphone shipments increased 2.3 percent YoY to 336.3 million units in the fourth quarter of last year. title: Apple Led Market as Global Smartphone Shipments Rose 2.3 Percent YoY in Q4 2025 Despite Growing Memory Shortage: IDC

description: CERT-In (or the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team) issued a new advisory note (CIVN–2026-0016) on Wednesday, warning Android users about a vulnerability that could be exploited by bad actors to execute code and gain access to their devices remotely. title: CERT-In Urges Android Users to Update Smartphones After Google Patches Critical Dolby Vulnerability
